terms_note: ordered products M_y^dagger M_x, x != y, of each generator's LCU (docs/SPEC-SA.md section 3): 4 per one-body eigenvector (2 spins x 2 orders) and (2B+1) 2B per (r, c) square
lambda_note: Lambda = sum_r |e_r| + (1/4) sum_rc (|wB_rc| + sum_b |w_rcb|)^2 = (1/2) sum_alpha lambda_alpha^2, the block-encoding normalization of the spectrum-amplified walk (Low et al. 2025 Eq. (33))
lambda_flat_note: sum of the ordered-product coefficients c_t (the rounding error is summed over these terms)
identity_note: sos_const + sum_rc (wB_rc^2 / 2 + sum_b w_rcb^2 / 4): H_spec = identity + sum_t c_t M_t
E_SOS_note: sos_const - sum_r |e_r|: H_spec - E_SOS = sum_alpha O^dagger O is positive semidefinite on all of Fock space

parameters_source.RBC: final_rbc_systems.csv row FeMoco76: R, B, C = 15, 57, 19
parameters_source.rotation_bits: get_walk_counts_different_bits_adjustments_for_paper_revision.py (Zenodo 17066718, md5 41c45e6ce7c1c1df910d352d040daa1f), run unchanged: prints "do.sys_name='FeMoco54' target_error=0.83 Coeff bits: 9.00 Rot bits: 16.00" and "do.sys_name='FeMoco76' target_error=0.83 Coeff bits: 9.00 Rot bits: 15.00", and with those bits "FeMoco54 10203 1132  3.42e+08" and "FeMoco76 14629 1454  1.00e+09" (the journal's Cost[BE], qubits and totals)
parameters_source.authors_keep_bits: the same script: 'Coeff bits: 9.00' (the alias keep precision they cost). Not a spec parameter: a lane map chooses its own keep bits and must meet this harness's 0.1 mHa rounding rule
parameters_source.electrons: Reiher et al. 2017: 54 electrons; Li et al. 2019: 113 electrons (data/femoco/SOURCES.json); the BLISS shift in the factors is for this electron count

published.location: Low et al. 2025, Phys. Rev. X 15, 041016, doi:10.1103/pb2g-j9cw, Table V (top), DFTHC + BLISS + SA block (rows Lambda/Ha, E_gap/Ha, lambda_eff/Ha, eps_corr/mHa, Cost[BE], Qubits) and Table I; the record's final_rbc_systems.csv (md5 962340e5cf8f2f177108b5c8e4f26cdd)
published.E_gap_note: their E_gap is the CSV's HF-adjusted SOS gap (pickle sos_gap - old DMRG energy + the DFTHC Hamiltonian's HF energy), not CCSD(T) as the text says (references/REFERENCES.md)

reproduced.what: the authors' own quantities recomputed in float64 from the float32 factors and the pinned integrals (their functions, before rotation rounding); Lambda of this spec (exact, quantized networks do not enter Lambda) equals lambda_DFTHC here up to the float64 eigendecomposition
reproduced.note: the pickle's values were computed by the authors in float32 (jax). H0 agrees to float32 precision (Reiher; Li's pickle H0 includes the FCIDUMP core energy -21021.2140122 that eri_li.h5 and every Li spec here omit), lambda_DFTHC to 5e-7 relative: a float32 jax re-run of their functions on these inputs gives 58.343956 and 179.729599, so the residual is float32 evaluation, not a different operator

errors.name: sector
errors.how: H_spec equals the DFTHC operator only on the 113-electron sector: H_spec(unquantized) - H - (1/2) sum_pqrs D_pqrs Et_pq Et_rs = (N - eta)(alpha + (Hs/2).E), a BLISS term (checked in spin-free E-form to 1.2e-14 per one-body entry and 1.6e-12 Ha in the constant)

errors.name: dfthc_fit_frobenius
errors.how: the authors' metric error_h2: Frobenius norm over all (p,q,r,s) of D = sum_rc L_rc (x) L_rc - eri - (BLISS two-body shift); reproduces the pickle's error_h2

errors.name: dfthc_fit_bound
errors.how: on the sector, ||H_spec - H|| <= ||(1/2) sum D Et Et|| + angle_quantization + eigendecomposition, and ||Et_pq|| <= 2, so this term is at most 2 sum|D|; loose; float64-evaluated

errors.name: angle_quantization
errors.how: sum_r |e_r| eps_r + sum_rc S_rc sum_b |w_rcb| eps_rb, eps = 2 sqrt(1 - (u.u_hat)^2) = ||Z(u) - Z(u_hat)|| and ||O^2 - O_hat^2|| <= ||O - O_hat|| (||O|| + ||O_hat||); float64-evaluated

errors.name: one_body_eigendecomposition
errors.how: sum_i |eig_i(h1' - V diag(e) V^T)| bounds the one-body operator's change from storing float64 eigenpairs

errors.name: ccsd_t

X 15, 041016, Table V 'eps_corr /mHa' row; final_rbc_systems.csv 'dmrg dfthc delta ecorr' column); not recomputed here.
